title: anubhavanivedana — anu-p04
question: That mantra shines forth in which letter-arrangement is not distinguished. That mudrā arises in which entire bodily action is dissolved. That yoga spreads forth from which breath's flowing is exhausted. In the festivals of attaining Your abode, of the wise — what, what is indeed not wonderful? *Fidelity: preserved (all 4 verses, full pādas from T1). Added: connective phrasing only. Not-resolved: trispandabhāva read as inhalation/exhalation/juncture (marked); yataḥ read relatively; śāktaṃ dhāma r
